parts.text: I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, and I plan and run the flights by deciding which drone flies along which way, signing off the flight before it leaves, and potentially calling it off. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I use the service to find out which of my drones could get to where a job starts. Before and during a flight, things happen outside my control like whether the load is ready, the drone reaching its job points, and the drone arriving, while outside people and devices report these things.
